# meshstack_building_blocks (Data Source)

List building blocks, with optional filters. Each returned building block is read-only and mirrors the `meshstack_building_block` resource (`metadata`/`spec`/`status`/`all_inputs`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "meshstack_building_blocks" "all" {
  # All filters are optional. Only active building blocks are returned.

  # workspace_identifier = "my-workspace"
  # project_identifier   = "my-project"
  # platform_identifier  = "my-platform.my-location"
  # name                 = "my-building-block"

  # Filter by the owning building block definition (the definition, not a version):
  # definition_uuid = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"

  # Filter by a building block definition version, either by its UUID or by its number
  # (a plain "1" or a "v"-prefixed "v1" are both accepted):
  # version_uuid   = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  # version_number = "v1"

  # tenant_uuid = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  # target_kind = "meshTenant" # or "meshWorkspace"

  # A building block matches when it has any one of the listed values:
  # health_status = ["FAILED"]
  # action        = ["PROVIDE_INPUT", "APPROVE_RUN"]

  # Platform-operator scope (requires the MANAGED_BUILDINGBLOCK_LIST authority): list building
  # blocks created from definitions you own, even when they live in other workspaces.
  # managed_by_definition_uuid      = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  # managed_by_workspace_identifier = "my-workspace"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `action` (Set of String) Only return building blocks with one of these actions (see `status.action`). One of `PROVIDE_INPUT`, `WAITING_FOR_DEPENDENCY`, `APPROVE_RUN`, `REVIEW_DRIFT`, `PENDING`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `UPGRADE_AVAILABLE`, `REVIEW_ERRORS`, `REVIEW_ABORTED_RUN`, `NO_ACTION`; later meshStack releases may add values.
- `definition_uuid` (String) Only return building blocks created from the building block definition with this UUID (the definition, not a specific version).
- `health_status` (Set of String) Only return building blocks with one of these health statuses (see `status.health_status`). One of `NONE`, `SUCCEEDED`, `FAILED`, `DELETED`; later meshStack releases may add values.
- `managed_by_definition_uuid` (String) Platform-operator scope: return building blocks created from the definition owned by the caller with this UUID. Requires the `MANAGED_BUILDINGBLOCK_LIST` authority.
- `managed_by_workspace_identifier` (String) Platform-operator scope: return building blocks created from definitions owned by this workspace. Requires the `MANAGED_BUILDINGBLOCK_LIST` authority.
- `name` (String) Only return building blocks with this exact name.
- `platform_identifier` (String) Only return building blocks on this platform (`<platformInstance>.<location>`).
- `project_identifier` (String) Only return building blocks in this project.
- `target_kind` (String) Only return building blocks with this target kind. One of `meshTenant`, `meshWorkspace`.
- `tenant_uuid` (String) Only return building blocks targeting the tenant with this UUID.
- `version_number` (String) Only return building blocks created from this building block definition version number. Accepts a plain number (`1`) or a `v`-prefixed string (`v1`); the `v` is stripped server-side.
- `version_uuid` (String) Only return building blocks created from the building block definition version with this UUID.
- `workspace_identifier` (String) Only return building blocks owned by or assigned to this workspace.

### Read-Only

- `building_blocks` (Attributes List) The building blocks matching the given filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--building_blocks))

Read-Only:

Read-Only:

<a id="nestedatt--building_blocks--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `building_blocks.metadata`

Read-Only:

- `owned_by_workspace` (String) The workspace containing this building block.
- `uuid` (String) UUID which uniquely identifies the building block.


<a id="nestedatt--building_blocks--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `building_blocks.spec`

Read-Only:

- `building_block_definition_version_ref` (Attributes) References the building block definition version this building block is based on. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--building_blocks--spec--building_block_definition_version_ref))
- `display_name` (String) Display name for the building block as shown in meshPanel.
- `parent_building_block_refs` (Attributes Set) Set of refs to the parent building blocks this block depends on, forming a dependency hierarchy in which a parent's outputs can feed this block's inputs (see [building block concepts](https://docs.meshcloud.io/concepts/building-block/)). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--building_blocks--spec--parent_building_block_refs))
- `target_ref` (Attributes) References the building block target, a workspace or a tenant depending on the definition. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--building_blocks--spec--target_ref))

<a id="nestedatt--building_blocks--spec--building_block_definition_version_ref"></a>
### Nested Schema for `building_blocks.spec.building_block_definition_version_ref`

Read-Only:

- `kind` (String) meshObject type, always `meshBuildingBlockDefinitionVersion`.
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the building block definition version.


<a id="nestedatt--building_blocks--spec--parent_building_block_refs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `building_blocks.spec.parent_building_block_refs`

Read-Only:

- `kind` (String) meshObject type, always `meshBuildingBlock`.
- `uuid` (String) UUID (`metadata.uuid`) of the parent `meshBuildingBlock`.


<a id="nestedatt--building_blocks--spec--target_ref"></a>
### Nested Schema for `building_blocks.spec.target_ref`

Read-Only:

- `kind` (String) Target kind, one of `meshTenant`, `meshWorkspace`.

- `uuid` (String) UUID of the target tenant (for `meshTenant` targets).



<a id="nestedatt--building_blocks--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `building_blocks.status`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) What the building block needs next, as in the Action column of meshPanel. One of `PROVIDE_INPUT`, `WAITING_FOR_DEPENDENCY`, `APPROVE_RUN`, `REVIEW_DRIFT`, `PENDING`, `IN_PROGRESS`, `UPGRADE_AVAILABLE`, `REVIEW_ERRORS`, `REVIEW_ABORTED_RUN`, `NO_ACTION`. `PROVIDE_INPUT` covers user and operator input, `REVIEW_DRIFT` reports a dry run that detected changes, `REVIEW_ABORTED_RUN` an aborted or rejected latest run, and `UPGRADE_AVAILABLE` a building block that needs nothing else while a newer definition version exists. Later meshStack releases may add values, which `succeeded` reads as not succeeded.
- `force_purge` (Boolean) True once a purge has been requested for this building block. A purge removes the block without a destroy run, leaving its cloud resources unmanaged (the lifecycle still reaches DELETED).
- `health_status` (String) Outcome of the latest run that speaks for the building block. One of `NONE`, `SUCCEEDED`, `FAILED`, `DELETED`. Only a run that finished as succeeded or failed moves it: it keeps the previous outcome while a run is pending, in progress, waiting for input or approval, or after a run was aborted, and it stays `NONE` until the first run finished. Read `action` to tell these apart.
- `latest_dry_run_uuid` (String) UUID of the latest dry (DETECT) run, but only when it is the newest run; null otherwise.
- `latest_run_uuid` (String) UUID of the latest modifying (apply/destroy) run. Null when none exists.
- `outputs` (Attributes Map) Outputs of the building block, available after a successful run. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--building_blocks--status--outputs))
- `succeeded` (Boolean) True when the latest run succeeded and the building block needs no attention: `health_status` is `SUCCEEDED` and `action` is one of `NO_ACTION`, `UPGRADE_AVAILABLE`, `REVIEW_DRIFT`. On meshStack versions before the `REVIEW_ABORTED_RUN` action an aborted run reads as succeeded.

<a id="nestedatt--building_blocks--status--outputs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `building_blocks.status.outputs`

Read-Only:

- `assignment_type` (String) How the output value is assigned. One of `NONE`, `PLATFORM_TENANT_ID`, `SIGN_IN_URL`, `RESOURCE_URL`, `SUMMARY`.
- `value` (String) Output value. Use `jsondecode(...)` to obtain a polymorphic value depending on `value_type`.
- `value_type` (String) Data type of the value. One of `STRING`, `CODE`, `INTEGER`, `BOOLEAN`, `FILE`, `LIST`, `SINGLE_SELECT`, `MULTI_SELECT`.
